name: Rock garden
about: Mossy rocks, ferns and flowers around a little pond, with a gravel path.

layers.name: Pond and path
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig a square 2 by 2 at the back right and fill it with water. Dig a path from the front to the middle and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Rocks and plants
layers.tip: Build two rocks from cobblestone, mossy cobblestone, stone and andesite. Plant ferns and flowers around them. Get ferns with shears.

layers.name: Rock tops
layers.tip: A few more stones on top make the rocks taller.
